## Data analysis summary

This script show step by step data processing, transformation and statistical analysis. It provides details of the whole data analysis steps, depicting key steps and showing what parameters were used.

```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

#install.packages("pacman") Install once
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  janitor,
  ggsankeyfier,
  ineq,
  ggpubr,
  ggpmisc,
  ggrepel,
  broom,
  patchwork,
  ggsankey,
  viridis,
  Kendall,
  gtsummary,
  vcd,
  trend,
  FactoMineR,
  factoextra,
  ggExtra,
  pheatmap,
  treemapify,
  colorspace,
  viridisLite,
  reshape2
)

# Read and clean data
df_eDNA <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/df_eDNA.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

df_NA <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/species.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

df_clean <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/df_shaq.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

df_shaq <- df_clean

# Verify species names in GBIF and WoRMS
# source("scripts/match_data_in_WORMS_GBIF.R")
```

# Number of studies identified in the review process

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_studies <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    !grepl("^Integration",
           document_title,
           ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) |>
  distinct(document_title)

df_mention <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    !grepl("^Integration",
           document_title,
           ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) |>
  distinct(site, document_title) |>
  count(site, name = "count") |>
  mutate(
    percentage = round(count / sum(count), 2)
  )

df_unique <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    !grepl("^Integration",
           document_title,
           ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) |>
  distinct(site, document_title) |>
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      site %in% c("Tudor Creek",
                  "Mida Creek",
                  "Gazi Bay") ~ "All",
      TRUE ~ site
    )
  ) |>
  count(site, name = "count") |>
  mutate(
    percentage = round(count / sum(count), 2)
  )

total_frequency <- sum(df_mention$count)

total_frequency
```

# Historically documented taxa

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa <- df_clean |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(
    author != "Mwamburi et al,. 2023"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    document_class = case_when(
      document_class %in% c("Peer-reviewed", "Research article") ~ "Peer reviewed",
      document_class %in% c("Manual", "Grey source") ~ "Grey source",
      TRUE ~ document_class
    )
  ) |>
  replace_na(
    list(
      kingdom = "Animalia",
      class = "Teleostei",
      species = "fish"
    )
  )

kingdom <- taxa |>
  group_by(kingdom) |>
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phylum <- taxa |>
  group_by(phylum) |>
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

class <- taxa |>
  group_by(class) |>
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prop = N / sum(N) * 100
  )

family <- taxa |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

genera <- taxa |>
  group_by(genus) |>
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gttable <- taxa |>
  distinct(
    site, kingdom, phylum, class, family, species
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phylum = if_else(
      is.na(phylum) & class == "Teleostei",
      "Chordata",
      phylum
    )
  )

site_taxa <- gttable |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(class),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prop = count / sum(count) * 100
  )

class_richness <- gttable |>
  group_by(class) |>
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prop = count / sum(count) * 100
  )
```

# Publication frequency by forest formation

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

df_site <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    assessment_method != "eDNA"
  ) |>
  distinct(
    site, document_title
  ) |>
  count(
    site,
    name = "Publication"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    site = if_else(
      Publication < 2,
      "Others",
      site
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    Publication = sum(Publication),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Site = site
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(Publication / sum(Publication) * 100, 1),
    Label = as.character(Publication)
  )
```

## Techniques used in the historical surveys

```{r}
df_tools <- df_clean |>
  left_join(
    df_NA,
    by = "species",
    suffix = c("", ".ref")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    class = coalesce(
      class,
      class.ref,
      "Teleostei"
    ),
    phylum = case_when(
      phylum == "Chordata" &
        class %in% c("Teleostei", "Aves", "Mammalia") ~ class,
      TRUE ~ phylum
    ),
    tools = case_when(
      str_detect(
        tools,
        regex(
          "net|nets|sein|seins|gillnet|gillnets",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "Use of net",
      tools == "DNA based technique" ~ "eDNA",
      tools == "Direct observation" ~ "Observation",
      tools == "Review of existing Primary data" ~ "Review",
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(class),
    class != "Unknown",
    !grepl(
      "^Integration",
      document_title,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  distinct()


# Prepare tool-class combinations
df_tech <- df_tools |>
  select(
    tools,
    class
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(tools),
    !is.na(class)
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(
    tools = case_when(
      class == "Magnoliopsida" &
        tools %in% c("Microscopy", "Use of net") ~ "Transect",
      
      class == "Malacostraca" &
        tools == "Use of net" ~ "Observation",
      
      class == "Globothalamea" &
        tools == "eDNA" ~ "Microscopy",
      
      class %in% c("Ulvophyceae", "Florideophyceae") &
        tools == "Use of net" ~ "Observation",
      
      class == "Teleostei" &
        tools == "Observation" ~ "Use of net",
      
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  )

```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Prepare tool-class combinations
df_tech <- df_tools |>

  ) |>

      class == "Teleostei" &
        tools == "Observation" ~ "Use of net",
      
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  )


# Generate frequency matrix
freq_matrix <- df_tech |>
  count(
    tools,
    class
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tools,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("class")

freq_matrix


# Plot heatmap
pheat1 <- pheatmap(
  freq_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c("#0723DE", "white", "#AB1F03")
  )(100),
  breaks = seq(
    -4,
    4,
    length.out = 101
  ),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  angle_col = 90,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  labels_row = parse(
    text = paste0(
      "italic('",
      rownames(freq_matrix),
      "')"
    )
  ),
  cellwidth = 12,
  cellheight = 10
```

# Number of new species identified over the years

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
df_trend <- df_clean |>
  dplyr::select(
    year_of_publication,
    species,
    site,
    document_title
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  dplyr::rename(year = year_of_publication) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    Species = trimws(species),
    Site = trimws(site)
  )

# First year each species was recorded
first_records <- df_trend |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    First_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Number of newly recorded species per year
new_species_year <- first_records |>
  count(First_year, name = "New_species") |>
  dplyr::rename(year = First_year)

# Mann-Kendall test
mk_test <- MannKendall(new_species_year$New_species)

tau <- round(mk_test$tau, 3)

p_value <- format.pval(
  mk_test$sl,
  digits = 3,
  eps = 0.001
)

# Trend plot
pl_2 <- ggplot(
  new_species_year,
  aes(x = year, y = New_species)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = TRUE,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1991,
    y = max(new_species_year$New_species, na.rm = TRUE),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    label = paste0(
      "Mann–Kendall: τ = ", tau,
      ", p ", p_value
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  ggtitle(expression(bold("(b)"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1988, 2026),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "New taxa recorded"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
pl_2
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
df_chisq <- df_shaq |>
  drop_na() |>
  left_join(
    df_NA,
    by = "species",
    suffix = c("", ".ref")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    class = ifelse(
      is.na(class),
      class.ref,
      class
    ),
    class = replace_na(
      class,
      "Teleostei"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    class != "Unknown"
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  select(
    site, class, species, document_title
  ) |>
  drop_na(class) |>
  group_by(
    site, class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(species)
  )

tab <- df_chisq |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = site,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("class")

tab <- xtabs(
  count ~ class + site,
  data = df_chisq
)

print(tab)

chisq_test <- chisq.test(tab)

chisq_test

residuals <- chisq_test$stdres

res_df <- melt(
  residuals,
  varnames = c("Species", "Site"),
  value.name = "Residuals"
) |>
  drop_na()

vir1 <- ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(
    x = Site,
    y = Species,
    fill = Residuals
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white"

    ),
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
taxa <- df_clean |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(
    author != "Mwamburi et al,. 2023"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    document_class = case_when(
      document_class == "Peer-reviewed" ~ "Peer reviewed",
      document_class == "Manual" ~ "Grey source",
      document_class == "Research article" ~ "Peer reviewed",
      document_class == "Grey source" ~ "Grey source"
    )
  ) |>
  replace_na(
    list(
      class = "Teleostei",
      species = "fish",
      kingdom = "Animalia"
    )
  )

df_time <- taxa |>
  mutate(
    class = replace_na(class, "Teleostei"),
    phylum = case_when(
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Teleostei" ~ "Teleostei",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Aves" ~ "Aves",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Mammalia" ~ "Mammalia",
      kingdom == "Bacteria" ~ "Bacteria",
      kingdom == "Fungi" ~ "Fungi",
      TRUE ~ phylum
    ),
    tools = case_when(
      str_detect(
        tools,
        regex(
          "net|nets|sein|seins|gillnet|gillnets",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "Nets",
      tools == "DNA based technique" ~ "eDNA",
      tools == "Direct observation" ~ "Observation",
      tools == "Review of existing Primary data" ~ "Review",
      phylum %in% c(
        "Chlorophyta",
        "Tracheophyta",
        "Rhodophyta"
      ) &
        tools %in% c("Nets", "Microscopy") ~ "Transect",
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    class != "Unknown"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    year = year_of_publication
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phylum = if_else(
      phylum == "Chordata",
      class,
      phylum
    ),
    phylum = if_else(
      is.na(phylum) & class == "Teleostei",
      "Teleostei",
      phylum
    ),
    tools = case_when(
      phylum == "Teleostei" &
        tools %in% c(
          "eDNA",
          "Traps",
          "Transect",
          "Observation",
          "Microscopy"
        ) ~ "Nets",
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    tools,
    year,
    phylum,
    class,
    species,
    document_title
  ) |>
  drop_na(phylum) |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(
    year,
    class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  group_by(class) |> 
  mutate(
    n_occurrences = n(),
    total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    class = if_else(
      n_occurrences < 3 | total_count < 10,
      "Others",
      class
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-n_occurrences, -total_count)


df_year <- df_time |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  group_by(class) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative = cumsum(count)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

df_year$year <- as.numeric(df_year$year)

df_labels <- df_year |>
```

# Temporal patterns of biodiversity records

```{r}
taxa <- df_clean |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(
    author != "Mwamburi et al,. 2023"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    document_class = case_when(
      document_class %in% c("Peer-reviewed", "Research article") ~ "Peer reviewed",
      document_class %in% c("Manual", "Grey source") ~ "Grey source"
    )
  ) |>
  replace_na(
    list(
      class = "Teleostei",
      species = "fish",
      kingdom = "Animalia"
    )
  )

df_time <- taxa |>
  mutate(
    class = replace_na(class, "Teleostei"),
    phylum = case_when(
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Teleostei" ~ "Teleostei",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Aves" ~ "Aves",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Mammalia" ~ "Mammalia",
      kingdom == "Bacteria" ~ "Bacteria",
      kingdom == "Fungi" ~ "Fungi",
      TRUE ~ phylum
    ),
    tools = case_when(
      str_detect(
        tools,
        regex(
          "net|nets|sein|seins|gillnet|gillnets",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "Nets",
      tools == "DNA based technique" ~ "eDNA",
      tools == "Direct observation" ~ "Observation",
      tools == "Review of existing Primary data" ~ "Review",
      phylum %in% c(
        "Chlorophyta",
        "Tracheophyta",
        "Rhodophyta"
      ) &
        tools %in% c("Nets", "Microscopy") ~ "Transect",
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    class != "Unknown"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    year = year_of_publication
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phylum = if_else(
      phylum == "Chordata",
      class,
      phylum
    ),
    phylum = if_else(
      is.na(phylum) & class == "Teleostei",
      "Teleostei",
      phylum
    ),
    tools = case_when(
      phylum == "Teleostei" &
        tools %in% c(
          "eDNA",
          "Traps",
          "Transect",
          "Observation",
          "Microscopy"
        ) ~ "Nets",
      TRUE ~ tools
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    tools,
    year,
    phylum,
    class,
    species,
    document_title
  ) |>
  drop_na(phylum) |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(
    year,
    class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  group_by(class) |>
  mutate(
    n_occurrences = n(),
    total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    class = if_else(
      (n_occurrences == 1 | total_count < 5) &
        !class %in% c("Gastropoda", "Mammalia"),
      "Others",
      class
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-n_occurrences, -total_count)
```

```{r}
df_raw <- df_time

custom_colors <- c(
  "Aves"          = "#56B4E9",

  "Enoplea"       = "#E69F00",
  "Gastropoda"    = "#F0E442",

  "Malacostraca"  = "#CC79A7",
  "Mammalia"      = "#AA4499",
  "Others"        = "#999999",
  "Teleostei"     = "#0072B2"
)
df_stream <- df_raw |>
  group_by(
    year,
    class
  ) |>
  summarise(
    count = sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    class,
    fill = list(count = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    class = factor(
      class,
      levels = names(custom_colors)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    year,
    class
  )

df_stream <- df_stream |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(count) - sum(count) / 2,
    ymin = ymax - count
  ) |>
  ungroup()

df_smooth <- df_stream |>
  group_by(class) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    yrs <- seq(
      min(.x$year),
      max(.x$year),
      length.out = 200
    )

    tibble(
      year = yrs,
      ymin = spline(
        .x$year,
        .x$ymin,
        xout = yrs,
        method = "natural"
      )$y,
      ymax = spline(
        .x$year,
        .x$ymax,
        xout = yrs,
        method = "natural"
      )$y
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup()

stream_plot <- ggplot(
```

## Class-level deviation from expected taxonomic representation

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Prepare data for chi-square goodness-of-fit test
df_chi_sq <- df_clean |>
  select(-1) |>
  distinct() |>
  drop_na(class)


# Count observations per class
species_counts <- table(df_chi_sq$class)

species_counts


# Chi-square goodness-of-fit test
chi <- chisq.test(species_counts)

chi


# Extract standardized Pearson residuals
residuals <- chi$stdres

residuals


# Prepare residuals for plotting
res_df <- data.frame(
  Species = names(residuals),
  Residuals = residuals,
  Count = as.vector(species_counts)
)

res_df


# Plot standardized Pearson residuals
x1 <- ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(

      Species,
```

# Environmental DNA analysis

This section describes the workflow used for pre-processing, data wrangling, and validation of eDNA-derived biodiversity data. The workflow is organised into two sections. Section 1 describes the data cleaning and taxonomic validation steps used to generate the S6 data class. Section 2 uses the resulting S6 data class for downstream analysis.

## Section 1: Data cleaning and taxonomic validation

This section describes the data cleaning, wrangling, and taxonomic validation procedures used to generate the S6 data class. The workflow was run once to produce the S6 data class, which is then used as the input for subsequent analyses.

If the S6 data class is already available, this section does not need to be rerun. The S6 data class can instead be loaded directly and used for the analyses described in Section 2.

```{r}
# Load the required packages
# Install.packages("pacman"): Install only once
pacman::p_load(
  phyloseq,
  biomformat,
  tidyverse,
  rgbif,
  tidyr,
  worrms,
  microeco,
  magrittr,
  aplot,
  metacoder,
  janitor,
  lubridate,
  readr,
  dplyr,
  purrr,
  stringr,
  gt
)
```

### Importing the required data

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load the data
df1 <- read_csv(
  "data/taxa.csv"
)

df2 <- read_csv(
  "data/taxar.csv"
)


# Check similarity (optional diagnostics)
similar_columns <- intersect(
  names(df1),
  names(df2)
)

different_columns <- setdiff(
  union(
    names(df1),
    names(df2)
  ),
  similar_columns
)

cat(
  "Shared columns:",
  paste(
    similar_columns,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique columns:",
  paste(
    different_columns,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


# Merge files by a common identifier
merged_df <- merge(
  df1,
  df2,
  by = "name",
  all = TRUE
)


# Extract and sort column names from column 3 to 113
sorted_cols <- sort(
  names(merged_df)[1:116]
)


# Apply column selection and reordering
df_deDNA <- merged_df |>
  select(
    1:2,
    all_of(sorted_cols),
    everything()
  ) |>
  select(
    -lineage.x,
    -taxRank.y,
    -taxID.y,
    -lineage.y,
    -Max.x,
    -Max.y,
    -taxRank.x
  ) |>
  mutate(
    name = gsub(
      "\\[|\\]",
      "",
      name
    )
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ str_remove(
      .,
      "\\.cladeReads$"
    ),
    .cols = everything()
  ) |>
  relocate(
    taxID.x,
    .before = 2
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      3:109,
      ~ replace(
        .,
        is.na(.) | . < 5,
        0
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    if_any(
      .cols = 3:109,
      ~ . != 0
    )
  ) |>
  rename(
    scientific_name = name,
    otu = taxID.x
  ) |>
  select(
    scientific_name,
    otu,
    everything()
  ) |>
  drop_na(otu)
```

### Validation of eDNA detections against the regional species inventory

This section describes the validation of eDNA-derived species detection against a regional species inventory. Taxonomic names detected through eDNA are compared with species records compiled from regional biodiversity databases. The validation relies on the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF; https://www.gbif.org/) and requires an active internet connection to query and validate taxonomic names. This step is memory intensive and may require substantial RAM when processing large taxon lists.

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Filter out taxa that do not conform to binomial nomenclature
pattern <- "^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[A-Z]?[a-z]+$"


# Load inventoried data sets
gbif <- read_csv(
  "inventory_data/gbif_.csv"
) |>
  select(
    species
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  unique() |>
  rename(
    scienticname = species
  )

obis <- read_csv(
  "inventory_data/obis.csv"
) |>
  select(
    scientificname
  ) |>
  unique()

fishbase <- read_csv(
  "inventory_data/fishbase.csv"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    species
  ) |>
  unique() |>
  rename(
    scientificname = species
  )

worm <- read_csv(
  "inventory_data/WoRMS.csv"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    scientific_name
  ) |>
  unique() |>
  rename(
    scientificname = scientific_name
  )


# GBIF function
lit <- read_csv(
  "inventory_data/litsurv.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    taxon_name
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(
    !str_detect(
      taxon_name,
      regex(
        "\\b(sp|spp|sp1)(\\.|$)",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ),
    str_count(
      taxon_name,
      "\\S+"
    ) > 1
  )


# Batch function for GBIF database querying
check_names_batch <- function(
  names,
  batch_size = 100,
  output_file = "lit_checked_partial.csv"
) {
  batches <- split(
    names,
    ceiling(
      seq_along(names) / batch_size
    )
  )
  
  total_batches <- length(batches)
  
  results <- map2_dfr(
    batches,
    seq_along(batches),
    function(batch, idx) {
      message(
        "\n🔎 Processing batch ",
        idx,
        " of ",
        total_batches,
        " (",
        length(batch),
        " names)"
      )
      
      # Attempt query with retry logic
      for (attempt in 1:3) {
        res <- tryCatch(
          name_backbone_checklist(
            data.frame(
              name = batch
            )
          ),
          error = function(e) e
        )
        
        if (!inherits(res, "error")) {
          message(
            "✅ Batch ",
            idx,
            " completed successfully."
          )
          
          # Ensure consistent column types
          res <- res |>
            mutate(
              across(
                everything(),
                as.character
              )
            )
          
          if (!is.null(output_file)) {
            if (file.exists(output_file)) {
              existing <- read_csv(
                output_file,
                show_col_types = FALSE
              ) |>
                mutate(
                  across(
                    everything(),
                    as.character
                  )
                )
              
              combined <- bind_rows(
                existing,
                res
              )
              
              write_csv(
                combined,
                output_file
              )
            } else {
              write_csv(
                res,
                output_file
              )
            }
          }
          
          Sys.sleep(
            runif(
              1,
              1.5,
              3.5
            )
          )
          
          return(res)
        } else {
          message(
            "⚠️ Attempt ",
            attempt,
            " failed for batch ",
            idx,
            ": ",
            conditionMessage(res)
          )
          
          Sys.sleep(5)
        }
      }
      
      message(
        "❌ Batch ",
        idx,
        " failed after 3 attempts, skipping."
      )
      
      tibble()
    }
  )
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Break into sub-chunks of 50 names
match_worms_subchunk <- function(names_50) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      Sys.sleep(5)
      wm_records_names(names_50)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Error: ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
}


# Function to process one 1000-chunk
process_chunk <- function(species_chunk) {
  sub_chunks <- split(
    species_chunk,
    ceiling(
      seq_along(species_chunk) / 50
    )
  )
  
  map_dfr(
    sub_chunks,
    match_worms_subchunk
  )
}
```

### Habitat classification, taxonomic completion, and data integration

Following processing of the preceding datasets, habitat categories are standardised and missing taxonomic assignments, particularly family-level classifications, are completed using available reference sources. The resulting curated dataset is then converted into phyloseq and microeco data formats for downstream biodiversity and community analyses

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Prepare project data
df_project <- df_project_phylum |>
  distinct(
    otu,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Reclassify habitat values
    Habitat = case_when(
      Habitat %in% c(
        "Euryhaline",
        "Parasite"
      ) ~ "Brackish",
      TRUE ~ Habitat
    ),
    
    # Fill missing class values
    class = case_when(
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Amoeboaphelidium protococcarum" ~ "Aphelidea",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Ancoracysta twista" ~ "Nebulidea",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Cafileria marina" ~ "Bicosoecida",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Euplotes vanleeuwenhoeki" ~ "Spirotrichea",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Cyprinodontiformes" ~ "Teleostei",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Fundulus dispar" ~ "Teleostei",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Periophthalmus magnuspinnatus" ~ "Teleostei",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Priapulus caudatus" ~ "Priapulimorpha",
      is.na(class) &
        scientific_name == "Tetraodon biocellatus" ~ "Teleostei",
      TRUE ~ class
    ),
    
    # Fill missing family values
    family = case_when(
      is.na(family) &
        scientific_name == "Cafileria marina" ~ "Bicosoecidae",
      is.na(family) &
        scientific_name == "Cloacina communis" ~ "Chabertiidae",
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
df_micrltr <- readRDS(

# Remove OTUs with fewer than 20 contigs

df_divstat$sample_table <- subset(

)

df_divstat$filter_taxa(
  rel_abund = 0.00000102,
  freq = 1
)

df_divstat$tidy_dataset()


# Remove unexpected and non-marine taxa
df_marine <- clone(
  df_divstat
)

df_marine$tax_table <- subset(
  df_marine$tax_table,
  Habitat != "Terrestrial" &
    Habitat != "Freshwater" &
    status == "Expected"
)

# Clean and remove filtered metadata
df_marine$tidy_dataset()


# Extract OTU data
otu_data <- df_marine$tax_table


# Summarise unique taxonomic counts by kingdom
df_summary <- otu_data |>
  group_by(
    kingdom
  ) |>
  summarise(
    Unique_Phylum = n_distinct(phylum),
    Unique_Class = n_distinct(class),
    Unique_Order = n_distinct(order),
    Unique_Family = n_distinct(family),
    Unique_Genus = n_distinct(genus),
    Unique_Species = n_distinct(scientific_name)
  ) |>
  ungroup()


# Add total row
df_totals <- df_summary |>
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      sum
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    kingdom = "Total"
  )


# Bind totals to summary
df_final_summary <- bind_rows(
  df_summary,
```

```{r}
  )


# Species occurrence within the WIO region
df_occurance <- tax_data |>
  group_by(
    phylum
  ) |>
  mutate(
    kingdom = ifelse(
      is.na(kingdom),
      first(na.omit(kingdom)),
      kingdom
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(
    scientific_name != "Eukaryota sp. BB2"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    kingdom = ifelse(
      is.na(kingdom),
      "Chromista",
      kingdom
    )
  ) |>
  count(
    status,
    kingdom,
    name = "count"
  )


# Calculate total per status for label
total <- df_occurance |>
  group_by(
    status
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total = sum(count)
  ) |>
  ungroup()


d2 <- ggplot(
  df_occurance,
  aes(
    x = status,
    y = count,
    fill = kingdom
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",

  ) +
  xlab(

  ) +
  theme_classic() +

      label = total

  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(

      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    strip.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylab("")


# Load required library
pacman::p_load(

)


# Combine plots
```

## OTU structure and diversity

Subset Eukaryotas from the main data set. The main reason for analysis Microbes and Eukaryotas separately is because, microbes have proportionately high relative abundance, and this sometimes skews the analysis of Eukaryota taxa whose DNA are detected in lower proportion.


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Species richness
history <- taxa |>
  select(family, species) |>
  drop_na() |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarise(count = n_distinct(species))



ednah <- otu_data |>
  select(family, scientific_name) |>
  drop_na() |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarise(count = n_distinct(scientific_name))


ednahist <- full_join(ednah, history, by = "family",
                      suffix = c("_eDNA", "_hist"))
ednahist[is.na(ednahist)] <- 0

# Normality test

shapiro.test(ednahist$count_hist)
qqnorm(ednahist$count_eDNA)
qqnorm(ednahist$count_hist)

# Not normal Non parametric tes
wilcox.test(ednahist$count_eDNA,
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(patchwork)

# Data processing
df_hist <- taxa |>
  select(family) |>
  drop_na() |>
  distinct()



eDNA_data <- df_phylamarine$tax_table |>
  select(family) |>
   drop_na() |>
  distinct()

# Extract taxa column as a vector
deDNA_data <- unique(eDNA_data$family)
dhist_data <- unique(df_hist$family)


# Combine and create a presence-absence matrix----------------------------------
all_taxa <- unique(c(eDNA_data$family, df_hist$family))
pa_matrix <- data.frame(
  Taxon = all_taxa,
  eDNA = as.integer(all_taxa %in% eDNA_data$family),
  Historical = as.integer(all_taxa %in% df_hist$family)
)

#Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- pa_matrix |> 
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    eDNA == 1 & Historical == 1 ~ "Shared",
    eDNA == 1 & Historical == 0 ~ "Unique to eDNA",
    eDNA == 0 & Historical == 1 ~ "Unique to Historical",
    TRUE ~ "Neither"
  )) |> 
  count(Category)

# Add custom labels
plot_data <- plot_data |> 
  mutate(Label = case_when(
    Category == "Shared" ~ 67,
    Category == "Unique to eDNA" ~ 238,
    Category == "Unique to Historical" ~ 183,
    TRUE ~ n  
  ))

# Taxa unique to each technique
edna_uniq <- pa_matrix |>
  filter(eDNA == 1 &
         Historical == 0)

historycal <- pa_matrix |>
  filter(Historical == 1 &
           eDNA == 0)

shared_df <- pa_matrix |>
  filter(Historical == 1 &
           eDNA == 1)

# Make the bar plot with labels
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Category, y = n, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "grey100") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Shared" = "#D55E00",
    "Unique to eDNA" = "#89CFF0",
    "Unique to Historical" = "grey60",
    "Neither" = "grey30"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Category",
    y = "Number of Families"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

#Process eDNA data--------------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)

edna_df <- merged_df2 |>
  select(family, 11:27) |>

 distinct()

# Historical data

histo_df$method <- "Historical"

  # Add stress label
```

```{r}

comm <- clone(df_divstat)

# assign back the otu_table
data_new$otu_table <- your_transformed_otu_table
# go on
t1 <- trans_beta$new(dataset = data_new, group = "site")
t1$cal_ordination(ordination = "NMDS", NMDS_matrix = FALSE)
t1$plot_ordination(loading_arrow = FALSE)
t1$plot_transect(color = "site")


# Perform NMDS

             dist.method = "bray", # distance metric
             ord.method = "nmds")  # NMDS ordination

# Plot NMDS with grouping color
comm$beta$plot_ord(
  type = "nmds", 
  color = "Group",  # column in meta_table for color
  show.stress = TRUE,
  ellipse = TRUE,   # optional: draw group ellipses
  point.size = 3
)

source("scripts/ANOVA_PERMANOVA.R")


# Compute dissimilarity 
dist_mat <- vegdist(mat, method = "bray")

# Run ANOSIM
anosim_res <- anosim(dist_mat, grouping = metadata$method, permutations = 999)

# View results
print(anosim_res)

# Visualize
plot(anosim_res)

# Contributors of PERMANOVA difference
pomm_matrix <- all_data |> 
  group_by(SampleID, family) |> 
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = family,
    values_from = count,,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Extract site info
metadata_1 <- pomm_matrix |> 
  select(SampleID) |> 
  separate(SampleID, into = c("site", "method"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  filter(method == "eDNA")

# Remove ID and metadata cols to get numeric matrix
comm_abund_1 <- pomm_matrix |>
  filter(str_detect(SampleID, "_eDNA$")) |> 
  select(-SampleID)

comm_abund_1 <- as.data.frame(lapply(comm_abund_1, as.numeric))
comm_abund_1 <- as.matrix(comm_abund_1)


# SIMPER to identify contributing OTUs
simper_res <- simper(comm_abund_1,
                     group = metadata_1$site,
                     permutations = 999)

# View top contributors for each group comparison
summary(simper_res,
        ordered = TRUE)

# Suppose simper_res is your simper object
simper_df <- map_df(names(simper_res), function(contrast) {
  df <- as.data.frame(simper_res[[contrast]])
  df$Taxon <- rownames(df)
  df$Contrast <- contrast
  df
})

simper_sig <- simper_df %>%
  group_by(Contrast) %>%
  arrange(desc(average), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%   # top 10 per contrast
  ungroup()

# Reformat the graph and data and draw graph
contrast_res <- as.data.frame(simper_res$`Ungwana Bay_Vanga`)
head(contrast_res)
contrast_res$Taxon <- rownames(contrast_res)

simper_sig <- contrast_res %>%        # keep only significant taxa
  arrange(desc(average)) %>%   # sort by contribution
  slice(1:25)                  # top 10

ggplot(simper_sig, aes(x = reorder(Taxon, average), y = average)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Taxon", y = "Average contribution") +
  theme_alluvial()

```

```{r}
library(phylosmith)

nmds_phyloseq(df_phylo, c("site"), circle = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
```
